list.name: factory
list.label: Factory
list.definition: SELECT name AS "__text", code AS "__value" FROM factories WHERE "isActive" = true ORDER BY name
list.query: SELECT name AS "__text", code AS "__value" FROM factories WHERE "isActive" = true ORDER BY name

list.name: area
list.label: Area
list.definition: SELECT a.name AS "__text", a.id AS "__value" FROM areas a JOIN factories f ON f.id = a."factoryId" WHERE ('$factory' = '' OR f.code = '$factory') ORDER BY a.name
list.query: SELECT a.name AS "__text", a.id AS "__value" FROM areas a JOIN factories f ON f.id = a."factoryId" WHERE ('$factory' = '' OR f.code = '$factory') ORDER BY a.name

targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped AS (
    SELECT t."workOrderId" wo, t."sequenceOrder" seq, t."goodBase" gb, t."scrapBase" sb,
           t."plannedMin" pm, t."runMin" rm, t."idealRunMin" irm
    FROM production_snapshots t
    WHERE t.granularity='MINUTE' AND $__timeFilter(t."bucketStart") AND ('$factory'='' OR t."factoryId" IN (SELECT id FROM factories WHERE code='$factory'))
    AND ('$area'='' OR t."areaId"='$area')
    AND ('$line'='' OR t."lineId"='$line')
    AND ('$machine'='' OR t."machineId"='$machine')),
  fin AS (SELECT wo, MAX(seq) ms FROM scoped GROUP BY wo),
  agg AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.gb) FILTER (WHERE s.seq=f.ms),0) good, COALESCE(SUM(s.sb),0) scrap,
                 COALESCE(SUM(s.pm),0) ppt, COALESCE(SUM(s.rm),0) run, COALESCE(SUM(s.irm),0) earned
          FROM scoped s JOIN fin f ON f.wo=s.wo) SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(100.0*scrap/NULLIF(good+scrap,0),0)::numeric,2) AS value FROM agg

SELECT t."defectCategory" AS metric, SUM(t.quantity) AS value FROM ncrs t JOIN factories f ON f.id = t."factoryId" WHERE ('$factory' = '' OR f.code = '$factory') AND $__timeFilter(t."detectedAt") GROUP BY t."defectCategory" ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 12
